quarterly_data.quarter: Mastercard press release: Mastercard Advances Commercial Payments With AI-Powered B2B (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mastercard introduced Advanced B2B Analytics, a card-acceptance analytics platform with AI-powered supplier acceptance propensity scoring that helps issuers grow commercial card spend and corporates optimize working capital; Absa Group and Emirates NBD are among the first financial institutions offering it to their corporate clients. Mastercard puts the addressable B2B payments opportunity at approximately $80 trillion and calls this the first foundational B2B capability of its AI-powered commercial payments vision.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately $80 trillion addressable B2B payments opportunity
